steps.en: Open the app and choose a git, local or collection source
steps.zh: 打开应用，选择 git、本地或合集来源

steps.en: Discover skills and show selectable entries
steps.zh: 发现技能并展示可选条目

steps.en: Select skills, tags, target tools and installation scope
steps.zh: 选择技能、标签、目标工具与安装范围

steps.en: Store the library and deploy to the selected tool directories
steps.zh: 保存技能库并部署到选定工具目录

value.en: Manage one library instead of independent copies for every coding agent
value.zh: 管理同一技能库，不再为每个编码 agent 维护独立副本
